summary: Frontend-only test of the two new home features: Night Match Lights and Your Card Inside. Tested desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. Both features work. (1) Intro lights: headless runs at about 1 FPS and the first frame takes about 3s (shader compile), so with real-time timing the intro had already finished by the second rendered frame. To check it properly I slowed performance.now() to 0.1x and sampled the canvas with preserveDrawingBuffer. Mean canvas brightness went 6.7 (t=0.34s) -> 7.3 (0.93) -> 9.0 (1.17) -> 12.8 (1.56) -> 14.8 (2.24) -> 17.5 (2.57) -> 19.5 (3.16) -> 20.4 (3.25s), then stayed flat (20.3-20.4) up to 6s. There was a flicker dip at 1.74s (13.1 -> 10.8 -> 13.6). Frame grids show the towers lighting at different times: the right/off-screen glow first, then the top-left tower and cone around 2.5s, then the top-right tower around 3.2s. Signed out there is no hero-your-card-note. (2) Signed in as qa.pro, the note reads 'Your card “Rohan QA” is standing on the pitch ↓'. Clicking it smooth-scrolls to #templates (top about -0.2px). With the DOM hidden, the 3D centre card is Rohan QA (neon_energy face, no photo, placeholder avatar) and the back reads ROHAN QA / KABADDI with kabaddi stat labels. Arjun Mehra is replaced, the side cards are Marcus Vance and Julian Ortega, and the gold ring shows under the card. (3) In /create I uploaded a photo, set the name to 'TEST Snap' and clicked export-download-card-button. fc_last_card was written with {u: user_3LuYV3..., url (jpeg, 61KB), at, sport_id: cricket, template_id: neon_energy, data}. Back on home the note says “TEST Snap” and the 3D front is the downloaded image with the photo. No server card was created (/me/cards still has only Rohan QA). (4) After signing out through the Clerk UserButton, the note is gone, Arjun Mehra is back and the ring is gone. (5) Scoping works: an fc_last_card with a different u is ignored and the server card 'Rohan QA' is shown. (6) Regression: exactly 1 canvas (also after explore -> back), all 8 section ids are present, 25 featured-template links, the hero buttons and explore navigation work, 0 console errors and 0 page errors in every run (the html-to-image cssRules noise from iteration 6 did not show), no horizontal overflow on mobile.

design_issues.screen: Home #templates after clicking hero-your-card-note (desktop and mobile)
issues: The note promises the card is 'standing on the pitch', but where scrollIntoView lands (templates top = 0) the 3D card sits right behind the '02 25 ORIGINAL DESIGNS' heading panel (bg /80 + blur) and the template rail. Only a sliver of 'ROHAN QA' is visible. On mobile it is almost fully covered. Options: scroll to (templates top - 0.35*innerHeight) so the clear 'window' area shows the card, or move the templates camera key or the card so it frames above the heading.

design_issues.screen: Night Match intro on slow devices
issues: The intro is timed with clock.elapsedTime from the first frame. On slow GPUs the first render (shader compile) takes about 3s, so users see the lights already almost fully on and miss the flicker. Consider starting the intro clock after the first rendered frame (for example, record t0 on the first useFrame and use t - t0), or call gl.compile() before starting.

critical_code_review_comments: lastCard.js: fc_last_card (which includes the user's photo in the JPEG) stays in localStorage after sign-out. It is correctly scoped by user_id, so nobody else sees it, but on a shared device the photo stays on disk. Consider clearing it on sign-out, or say so in the privacy copy ('Photos stay on your device' is technically true).

Home.useMyLatestCard: the effect depends on sports/templates array identity and calls api('get','/me/cards') on every home mount. That is fine, but there is no cancel flag, so a late response after sign-out could setMine on a stale user. Add an `off` guard in the cleanup.
Home.useMyLatestCard: useLocal compares local.at with the server updated_at - 60s, so a snapshot downloaded within 60s before a newer server save still wins. That is acceptable but worth documenting.
HomeWorld MyCardSpot: the pointLight (intensity 50) is not part of the intro ramp, so for signed-in users the centre card is lit before the floodlights come on. It is minor and arguably a nice touch.
HomeWorld: on mobile useCardImages([0]) means that when `mine` exists no demo cards are shown (demoCards[1] and [2] are undefined), so only the user's card is on the pitch. This is probably intended.
rememberCard is fire-and-forget after toPng with .catch(()=>{}). Storage quota errors are swallowed silently. This is OK.
action_items: Make the hero-your-card-note scroll target (or the templates camera key) frame the 3D user card in the clear area, not behind the #templates heading panel (desktop and mobile).
Optional: start the floodlight intro timing from the first rendered frame so slow devices still see the flicker.
Optional: clear fc_last_card on sign-out, and add a cancel guard in useMyLatestCard.
seed_data_creation: No server records were created. One Card PNG export as qa.pro used 1 card credit (15 -> 14 of 15 this cycle), and an export/card_created event was logged. fc_last_card was written only in the ephemeral test browser contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clerk sign-in on a fresh context may land on /sign-in/client-trust and ask for OTP 424242. Type it into input[autocomplete=one-time-code]. Signing out revokes the session, so saved storage_state cookies stop working after that. Testing the intro: headless is about 1 FPS with a roughly 3s first frame, so slow time with an add_init_script that overrides performance.now = base + (real-base)*0.1, force preserveDrawingBuffer:true on webgl getContext, and sample the canvas with drawImage every 300ms. To see the 3D card, hide '#templates > div, #sports > div, header, nav, [data-testid=stadium-hero]' and scroll to templates top - 0.35*innerHeight. qa.pro saved card id 74ee9ead-a4bd-4135-9885-d996f399a986 'Rohan QA' (kabaddi, neon_energy).
rca of the issue: Card hidden after clicking the note: StadiumHero calls scrollIntoView on #templates, so the section top sits at viewport y=0. The Section heading panel then sits in the middle of the viewport, which is where the camera (KEYS templates v(0,3.4,12) -> look v(0,2.2,0)) projects the centre card.
